concerns.text: T014 requires verifying checksums against `QWEN_IMAGE_2_0_SHA256` in `code/config.py`, but no task exists to populate this constant with the value from the official Technical Report. This creates a silent relaxation of FR-001 (Fetch & Verify) because the verification logic is impossible to execute as specified, effectively turning a hard constraint into a non-functional stub.

T032 implements the 'Paired T-Test' (FR-006) using `statsmodels.stats.weightstats.ttest_ind` (independent samples). This is a semantic weakening of the FR-006 requirement for a 'Paired' test on per-prompt degradation. The task must use `ttest_rel` or a custom paired implementation to satisfy the spec's statistical integrity constraint.

T045 implements the External Consistency Check (FR-008) using `HuggingFaceH4/image-reward` as a proxy. However, Constitution Principle VI mandates using 'the same VLM-based reward models from the original paper' for evaluation metrics. Replacing the VLM scoring entirely with a different model for the correlation check violates the 'same evaluation metrics' constraint, potentially invalidating the comparison.

T034 (Power Gate) is a critical dependency for T015b/T020b (Full Run), yet the task description fails to define the mechanism for scaling the Pilot (N=20) to the Full set (N=500) if the gate returns 'GO'. Without a defined scaling logic or sample size determination rule in the task, the Full Run scope is undefined, violating the requirement for a deterministic execution plan.

T006a (dependency check) depends on `VARIANCE_THRESHOLD` in `code/config.py`, but T006 (which initializes this key) is marked `[P]` (parallel). If T006a executes before T006, the task will fail. This introduces a race condition that violates the deterministic execution constraint required for the foundational phase.
